questions.question_text: You need to create a storage account that provides high availability by replicating data across multiple regions. Which redundancy option should you choose?
questions.explanation: Geo-zone-redundant storage (GZRS) provides high availability by replicating your data across multiple regions, ensuring data durability even in the event of a regional outage. More details can be found in the Microsoft Learn documentation.

questions.question_text: Which encryption type is enabled by default when you create a new Azure Storage account?

options.label: B
options.text: Server-side encryption using Microsoft-managed keys (SSE with MMK)

options.label: D
options.text: Data encryption at rest using Transparent Data Encryption (TDE)

questions.explanation: By default, Azure Storage accounts use server-side encryption with Microsoft-managed keys (SSE with MMK) to encrypt data at rest. For more information, refer to the Microsoft Learn page on Azure Storage encryption.

questions.question_text: As an administrator, you need to copy a large amount of data from an on-premises location to Azure Blob Storage. Which tool would be most efficient for this task?
questions.explanation: AzCopy is a command-line utility designed for high-performance data transfers to and from Azure Storage, making it the most efficient choice for transferring large amounts of data. Further details can be found on Microsoft Learn.

questions.question_text: You are configuring object replication between two storage accounts. Which of the following must be identical in both source and destination storage accounts?
questions.explanation: For object replication in Azure Storage, the container names must be the same in both source and destination storage accounts. Refer to the Microsoft Learn documentation for more details.
